verified_evidence: Official authenticated Sketchfab free-download dialog: CC Attribution; commercial use allowed; author credit required.

restrictions: NoAI: not used as input to generative image/model tools or training.

modifications: Conventional rig posing and small looping skeletal gestures authored for learning, business and collaboration contexts.
Original furniture, workspace and business props, camera composition and sunset lighting.
Original photographic skin/hair/clothing colors removed. Source luminance compressed to narrow grayscale modulation, then mapped to orange satin clothing and pale amber frosted resin skin/hair.
Original normal maps retained with measured near-lossless web compression.
Rig-weight-based skin/hair versus clothing material grouping, clearcoat and restrained skin transmission.

web_delivery.textures: WebP; see optimization report for quality/error measurements
web_delivery.normal_encoding: WebP near-lossless quality 40, measured against losslessly resized source normals
web_delivery.color_encoding: WebP quality 90; narrow grayscale detail modulation with standard amber PBR factors
web_delivery.validation: All six encoded and decoded GLBs: zero validation errors; inherited non-root skin warnings remain.

posters: Conventional Blender renders of the same scene geometry; not AI-generated images or finished browser screenshots.
